description: MUTATES Scalingo infrastructure — restarts an app's containers. Optionally restart only specific process types via scope; omit scope to restart everything. Returns 202 Accepted (track via get_operation). Scalingo API: POST /v1/apps/{app}/restart.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

scope.description: Container types to restart, e.g. ["web","worker"]. Omit to restart all.

name: restart_app
title: Restart app
